name: Camp Washington
description_short: Episcopal camp and retreat center on a 300-acre campus in the Litchfield Hills (Lakeside, CT), founded in 1917. Week-long overnight Children's Camp (ages 7-12) and Teen Camp (ages 12-16), a 3-day Mini Camp (ages 5-10) and a Family Camp weekend. Open to campers of all faith traditions.

sessions.name: Family Camp (all ages, priced per person)

sources.note: 2027 sessions and regular prices (after March 20, 2027); early bird is $675 for week camps, $350 for Mini Camp

warnings: The 2026 season is over (today is 2026-10-13), and no 2027 information is posted. The listing shows 2026 for reference only.
This is a 'hold page' that mixes old material from 2018 to 2026 (2020 forms, 2021/2022/2025 fees, a 2019 open house). Only the 2026 block was used.
Family Camp is priced per person ($200 adult / $100 child, ages 4 & under free), so it has no single session price and is left out of price_min/price_max.
The 'Young Adult Camp' (ages 21-30, July 26-30) has no year and is not in the 2026 session list, so it was not recorded.
The Women's Camp and Young Adult Camp are adult programs, so the camp's top age is left empty.
Calling it a sleepaway camp is based on week-long Sunday–Friday sessions and mention of cabin staff. The page never says outright that campers stay overnight.
